styleException.reason: The swatch fill is the currently selected color, a runtime Hsv value with no fixed set of possibilities -- Tailwind only emits classes it can see statically in a consuming project's own source, so an arbitrary runtime color cannot be expressed as a static class.

colorException.reason: The area-thumb outline must stay visible against an arbitrary user-picked color; a semantic token could blend into some picked colors, defeating the affordance.

radiusException.reason: AreaThumb is the drag handle, a fixed circular affordance distinct from the area's own corner

inspirationNote: No shadcn equivalent. dioxus-components uses CSS modules (external style.css files), not Tailwind, so no Tailwind class-level comparison is possible there; dioxus-components' color_picker uses its own CSS custom properties, structurally not comparable class-for-class. border-white thumb exception already recorded.
